title: Illager Girls
description: A cute female redesign for the Illagers!
body:
Transform your raids and woodland mansions with beautifully redesigned female illagers featuring custom 3D models, detailed textures and dark gothic-inspired voice acting. Includes the Evoker, Pillager, Vindicator and Witch, all designed to fit naturally within Minecraft's vanilla style while adding a fresh and sinister feminine twist.

This resource pack requires support for Custom Entity Models (CEM). You can use a compatible version of OptiFine, or install the Entity Texture Features (ETF) and Entity Model Features (EMF) mods to ensure the custom models and textures work correctly.
